verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a REST API, webhooks, and MCP integrations for connecting external tools, but nothing documents a bulk data-export feature or open-format (mbox/CSV/JSON) export enabling a user to fully extract their mail, contacts, and conversation history and leave the platform. Probes for docs/API artifacts (llms.txt, openapi) also 404, further indicating no dedicated export-and-leave capability is documented.
